cards.name: Young Deathclaws
lines: Each creature card in your graveyard has scavenge. The scavenge cost is equal to its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A static cannot grant each creature card in your graveyard a scavenge ability whose cost equals that card's own mana cost.

cards.name: Mark of Sakiko
lines: Enchanted creature has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, add that much {G}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end."
cards.backTranslation: Enchanted creature has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, add {G} equal to the damage dealt. This mana is persistent."
differences: Text A's mana is kept only until end of turn (it is not lost as steps and phases end, until end of turn); Text B says the mana is persistent with no such until-end-of-turn duration.

cards.name: Vizier of Remedies
lines: If one or more -1/-1 counters would be put on a creature you control, that many -1/-1 counters minus one are put on it instead.
cards.backTranslation: If a -1/-1 counter would be put on a creature you control, put one fewer -1/-1 counter on it instead.
differences: Text A replaces a single event that puts N -1/-1 counters with N-1 counters; Text B replaces each individual -1/-1 counter with one fewer, so when several -1/-1 counters are put on a creature you control at once, Text B puts zero where Text A puts N-1.

cards.name: Razorlash Transmogrant
lines: {4}{B}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. This ability costs {4} less to activate if an opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The line's return-from-graveyard ability with a +1/+1 counter has a cost reduction that depends on an opponent (not the total of opponents) controlling four or more nonbasic lands, and the schema has no per-opponent land-count condition on a self-cost reduction combined with returning the source from the graveyard with a counter.

cards.name: Yennett, Cryptic Sovereign
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, reveal the top card of your library. You may cast it without paying its mana cost if its mana value is odd. If you don't cast it, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No selector or condition tests for an odd mana value, and no op reveals the top card and then casts it free or draws it instead.

cards.name: Mana Web
lines: Whenever a land an opponent controls is tapped for mana, tap all lands that player controls that could produce any type of mana that land could produce.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The tap-all effect must select only the opponent's lands that could produce a type of mana the tapped land could produce, and no selector reads a land's producible mana types.

cards.name: Face of Divinity
lines: As long as another Aura is attached to enchanted creature, it has first strike and lifelink.
cards.inexpressibleReason: aurasAttachedToSource counts the Auras attached to this Aura itself, not those attached to the enchanted creature, so 'another Aura is attached to enchanted creature' cannot be tested.

cards.name: Blood Curdle
lines: Destroy target creature. Put a menace counter on a creature you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A menace counter has no engine rule that grants menace, so placing one on a creature cannot be expressed faithfully.

cards.name: Clan Crafter
lines: Commander creatures you own have "{2}, Sacrifice an artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and draw a card."
cards.backTranslation: Each creature you own that is a commander has "{2}, Sacrifice an artifact you control (this creature can be sacrificed to pay this cost): Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Draw a card."

cards.name: Pair o' Dice Lost
lines: Roll two six-sided dice. Return any number of cards with total mana value X or less from your graveyard to your hand, where X is the total of those results. Exile ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no die roll and no Value for the total of rolled dice used to bound the return.

cards.name: Brush Off
lines: This spell costs {1}{U} less to cast if it targets an instant or sorcery spell.
cards.backTranslation: Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast, and the blue portion of their cost is reduced by {U}. This applies only to spells its controller casts.
differences: Text A's reduction applies only if the spell targets an instant or sorcery spell; Text B reduces every instant or sorcery spell its controller casts, with no targeting condition.
Text B reduces the blue portion of the cost by {U} as an extra effect; Text A reduces only the generic cost of {1}{U}, with no separate blue reduction for non-targeting casts.
Text B applies to all instant and sorcery spells cast, while Text A is a conditional reduction on this card's own cast only, so the scope of the reduction differs.

cards.name: Tide Skimmer
lines: Whenever you attack with two or more creatures with flying, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you declare attackers, if you attack with at least two creatures with flying, draw a card.

cards.name: Tainted Adversary
lines: When this creature enters, you may pay {2}{B} any number of times. When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature, then create twice that many 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens with decayed.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no repeated optional payment of {2}{B} on entry that scales the counters and the number of decayed Zombie tokens by the number of payments.

cards.name: Blessing of Frost
lines: Distribute X +1/+1 counters among any number of creatures you control, where X is the amount of {S} spent to cast this spell. Then draw a card for each creature you control with power 4 or greater.
cards.inexpressibleReason: X is the amount of {S} spent to cast the spell, which no Value expresses, and no op distributes +1/+1 counters among any number of chosen creatures you control.

cards.name: King Macar, the Gold-Cursed
lines: Whenever ~ becomes untapped, you may exile target creature. If you do, create a Gold token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no 'becomes untapped' trigger event, so the Inspired trigger cannot be stated.

cards.name: Draconic Destiny
lines: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has flying, haste, and "{1}: ~ gets +1/+0 until end of turn." It's a Dragon in addition to its other types.
cards.backTranslation:
Enchanted creature gets +1/+1, has flying and haste, and is a Dragon in addition to its other creature types.
Enchanted creature has "{1}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn."

cards.name: Battle at the Bridge
lines: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn. You gain X life.
cards.backTranslation: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn. You gain X life.

cards.name: Chaotic Transformation
lines: Exile up to one target artifact, up to one target creature, up to one target enchantment, up to one target planeswalker, and/or up to one target land. For each permanent exiled this way, its controller reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a card that shares a card type with it, puts that card onto the battlefield, then shuffles.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op reveals cards from the top of a library until one sharing a card type with the exiled permanent is found and puts that card onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Dragon Turtle
lines: Drag Below — When this creature enters, tap it and up to one target creature an opponent controls. They don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no duration for a targeted creature to skip its controller's next untap steps (the only untap-skip is the permanent-level doesntUntapDuringUntapStep flag, which would also stop the Dragon Turtle itself and cannot be scoped to one turn-cycle).

cards.name: Reaper of Sheoldred
lines: Whenever a source deals damage to this creature, that source's controller gets a poison counter.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A dealtDamage trigger has no reference to the source of the damage, so 'that source's controller gets a poison counter' cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Mogg Maniac
lines: Whenever this creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
cards.inexpressibleReason: "Target opponent or planeswalker" restricts only the player half, but a target slot's controller restriction applies to both halves, so it cannot allow any planeswalker while restricting the player to an opponent.

cards.name: Invisible Woman, Sue Storm
lines: Whenever you put one or more +1/+1 counters on one or more other Heroes you control, you may create a 0/4 colorless Wall creature token with defender.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters that you put on one or more other Hero creatures you control, you may create a 0/4 colorless Wall creature token with defender.

cards.name: Cenote Scout
lines: When this creature enters, it explores.

smoke.detail: threw: event object information has no bound event object

cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, this creature explores.

cards.name: Council's Deliberation
lines: Whenever you scry, if you control an Island, you may exile this card from your graveyard. If you do, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no 'whenever you scry' trigger event, so the scry-triggered graveyard draw cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Dragon Egg
lines: When this creature dies, create a 2/2 red Dragon creature token with flying and "{R}: ~ gets +1/+0 until end of turn."
cards.backTranslation: When this creature dies, create a token that is a 2/2 red Dragon creature with flying. That token has "{R}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn."

cards.name: Spread the Sickness
lines: Destroy target creature, then proliferate.

cards.name: Web of Inertia
lines: At the beginning of combat on each opponent's turn, that player may exile a card from their graveyard. If the player doesn't, creatures they control can't attack you this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no way to let the opponent (the event player) optionally exile a card from their own graveyard, with the 'creatures they control can't attack you this turn' fallback applying only if they decline.

cards.name: Byway Barterer
lines: Whenever you expend 4, you may discard your hand. If you do, draw two cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no expend trigger ("whenever you expend 4").

cards.name: Bumi's Feast Lecture
lines: Create a Food token. Then earthbend X, where X is twice the number of Foods you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Earthbend X (a target land becomes a 0/0 haste creature with X +1/+1 counters that returns when it dies or is exiled) has no op in the schema.

cards.name: Living Laser
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, for each card you've discarded this turn, create a token that's a copy of ~, except the token isn't legendary. The tokens enter tapped and attacking. Exile the tokens at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No value counts the cards you have discarded this turn, so the number of token copies created on attack cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Mindlink Mech
lines: Whenever this Vehicle becomes crewed for the first time each turn, until end of turn, this Vehicle becomes a copy of target nonlegendary creature that crewed it this turn, except it's 4/3, it's a Vehicle artifact in addition to its other types, and it has flying.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target restriction 'nonlegendary creature that crewed it this turn' cannot be expressed, since no selector reads which creatures crewed this Vehicle this turn.

cards.name: Aethersnipe
lines: Evoke {1}{U}{U}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Evoke's sacrifice-on-enter cannot be conditioned on the spell having been cast for its evoke cost, since no condition or alternative-cast marker records that.

cards.name: Ainok Wayfarer
lines: When this creature enters, mill three cards. You may put a land card from among them into your hand. If you don't, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no branch on whether the player took a land from the milled cards, so 'if you don't, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Moonring Island
lines: {U}, {T}: Look at the top card of target player's library. Activate only if you control two or more blue permanents.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op looks at the top card of a target player's library: lookAtTopN rearranges the rest of the library, and lookTopLibrary is a controller-only permission rather than an effect.

cards.name: Crab Umbra
lines: Umbra armor
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no replacement effect for 'if enchanted creature would be destroyed, instead remove all damage from it and destroy this Aura' (umbra armor).

cards.name: Spark Harvest
lines: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or pay {3}{B}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The additional cost is a choice between sacrificing a creature and paying {3}{B}, and the schema has no way to offer a non-mana additional-cost alternative without also leaving the base cost castable for free.

cards.name: Purestrain Genestealer
lines: Vanguard Species — Whenever this creature attacks, you may remove a +1/+1 counter from it. If you do, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The search must happen only if a +1/+1 counter was actually removed ("if you do" gated on a counter removal), and no effect or condition gates a search on a counter removal succeeding.

cards.name: Cairn Wanderer
lines: As long as a creature card with flying is in a graveyard, this creature has flying. The same is true for fear, first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, landwalk, lifelink, protection, reach, trample, shroud, and vigilance.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A static keyword grant conditioned on a creature card with a given keyword in any graveyard, and the fear and landwalk keywords, have no representation in the schema.

cards.name: Gather the Townsfolk
lines: If you have 5 or less life, create five of those tokens instead.
cards.backTranslation:
Create two 1/1 white Human creature tokens.
If your life total is 5 or less, create three 1/1 white Human creature tokens.
differences: With 5 or less life, Text A creates five Human tokens instead of two; Text B creates three Human tokens instead.

cards.name: Quiet Speculation
lines: Search target player's library for up to three cards with flashback and put them into that player's graveyard. Then the player shuffles.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no selector for cards with flashback, so 'search for up to three cards with flashback' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Retrofitted Transmogrant
lines: {3}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with two +1/+1 counters on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Returning this card from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with two +1/+1 counters has no schema form: the return-with-counter ops place a single counter and have no count.

cards.name: Curse of the Nightly Hunt
lines: Creatures enchanted player controls attack each combat if able.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The static needs a selector for creatures controlled by the enchanted player, and the schema's selectors have no enchanted-player controller form.

cards.name: Chain Devil
lines: Animate Chains — When this creature enters, each player sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.
cards.inexpressibleReason: sacrificeEachPlayer's filter only supports 'creature' or 'any', so the 'nontoken creature' restriction on each player's sacrifice cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Rift Elemental
lines: {1}{R}, Remove a time counter from a permanent you control or suspended card you own: ~ gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost 'remove a time counter from a permanent you control or suspended card you own' has no form: removeCountersFromAmong selects permanents only, and a suspended card is in exile, not on the battlefield.

cards.name: Phantom Train
lines: Sacrifice another artifact or creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on this Vehicle. It becomes a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Sacrifice another artifact or creature you control: Put a +1/+1 counter on this permanent. It becomes a 4/4 Spirit creature until end of turn. It gains no keywords.
differences: Text B makes the creature a 4/4 base size; Text A only adds the Spirit artifact creature type and does not set power or toughness.
Text B says the creature gains no keywords, which removes trample during the effect; Text A does not remove any keyword.

cards.name: The Seventh Doctor
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, choose a card in your hand. Defending player guesses whether that card's mana value is greater than the number of artifacts you control. If they guessed wrong, you may cast it without paying its mana cost. If you don't cast a spell this way, investigate.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The defending player's guess about the chosen card's mana value and the conditional free cast of that card have no op or choice model.

cards.name: Hollowhead Sliver
lines: Sliver creatures you control have "{T}, Discard a card: Draw a card."
cards.backTranslation: Each Sliver creature you control has "{T}, Discard a card: Draw a card."

cards.name: Riftstone Portal
lines: As long as this card is in your graveyard, lands you control have "{T}: Add {G} or {W}."
cards.inexpressibleReason: A static effect cannot be conditioned on this card being in its owner's graveyard (no zone-of-source condition exists), so the graveyard-only mana grant cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Cut Propulsion
lines: Target creature deals damage to itself equal to its power. If that creature has flying, it deals twice that much damage to itself instead.
cards.backTranslation: Choose target creature. This spell deals damage to that creature. If the creature has flying, the damage equals twice its power. Otherwise, the damage equals its power.

cards.name: Lumbering Megasloth
lines: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each counter among players and permanents.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost reduction per counter among all players and permanents has no schema Value: countersOnSelf and allCountersOnSelf read only this permanent, and no Value totals counters on players.

cards.name: Confound
lines: Counter target spell that targets a creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no target filter for a spell that targets a creature; spellTargetsPermanentYouControl and stackTargetsYouOrCreatureYouControl cover other cases and a Selector cannot read what a spell targets.

cards.name: Fumble
lines: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Gain control of all Auras and Equipment that were attached to it, then attach them to another creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect gains control of all Auras and Equipment attached to a creature and then attaches them to another creature.

cards.name: Hatchery Spider
lines: When you cast this spell, reveal the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard. You may put a green permanent card with mana value X or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: lookAtTopN takes a fixed number of cards, so the reveal of X cards where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Rhino's Rampage
lines: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. It fights target creature an opponent controls. When excess damage is dealt to the creature an opponent controls this way, destroy up to one target noncreature artifact with mana value 3 or less.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The 'when excess damage is dealt to the creature an opponent controls this way' reflexive trigger has no schema event or condition for excess damage.

cards.name: Vow of Flight
lines: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2, has flying, and can't attack you or planeswalkers you control.
cards.backTranslation:
Enchant creature.
Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has flying.
Enchanted creature has an attack restriction that includes planeswalkers.
differences: Text A's restriction is that the enchanted creature can't attack you or planeswalkers you control; Text B's restriction covers only planeswalkers and omits attacking the controller ('you').

cards.name: Blanchwood Prowler
lines: When this creature enters, mill three cards. You may put a land card from among the cards milled this way into your hand. If you don't, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: millThenReturnMilledCard is mandatory when a matching card exists and has no optional form, and no else branch places a +1/+1 counter only when the player declines to return the land.

cards.name: Erestor of the Council
lines: Whenever players finish voting, each opponent who voted for a choice you voted for creates a Treasure token. You scry X, where X is the number of opponents who voted for a choice you didn't vote for. Draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no trigger for players finishing a vote and no value counting opponents' votes that matched or differed from the controller's votes.

cards.name: Mikey & Don, Party Planners
lines: You may play lands and cast Mutant, Ninja, or Turtle spells from the top of your library. If you cast a creature spell this way, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The extra +1/+1 counter on creature spells cast from the top of the library has no condition on the cast zone, since entersWithCounters is unconditional.

cards.name: Teachings of the Archaics
lines: If an opponent has more cards in hand than you, draw two cards. Draw three cards instead if an opponent has at least four more cards in hand than you.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition comparing an opponent's hand size with yours (eventPlayerHandSize and cardsInTargetHand do not express a per-opponent hand-size difference).

cards.name: Urge to Feed
lines: Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn. You may tap any number of untapped Vampire creatures you control. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each of those Vampires.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A resolution-time optional choice to tap any number of untapped Vampires and then put a counter on each one tapped has no schema form; tapXOthers and tapOthers are activation costs only.

cards.name: Goblin Assassin
lines: Whenever this creature or another Goblin enters, each player flips a coin. Each player whose coin comes up tails sacrifices a creature of their choice.
cards.inexpressibleReason: flipCoin lets only the controller flip, so each player flipping a coin and sacrificing on tails cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Illicit Auction
lines: Each player may bid life for control of target creature. You start the bidding with a bid of 0. In turn order, each player may top the high bid. The bidding ends if the high bid stands. The high bidder loses life equal to the high bid and gains control of the creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op models a bidding sequence in which each player in turn may top a life bid for control of the target creature.

cards.name: Gristle Glutton
lines: {T}, Blight 1: Discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Blight 1 (putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control as part of the cost) is not an AbilityCost kind in the schema.

cards.name: Ugin's Conjurant
lines: If damage would be dealt to this creature while it has a +1/+1 counter on it, prevent that damage and remove that many +1/+1 counters from this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no damage prevention that removes that many +1/+1 counters from the creature as the damage is prevented (createDamageShield is a one-shot shield with no counter removal).

cards.name: Awakening of Vitu-Ghazi
lines: Put nine +1/+1 counters on target land you control. It becomes a legendary 0/0 Elemental creature with haste named Vitu-Ghazi. It's still a land.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema's becomeCreatureUntilEot is until end of turn only, and cannot make a land a permanent legendary 0/0 creature named Vitu-Ghazi with haste.

cards.name: Brambleguard Captain
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.

cards.name: Judgment of Alexander
lines: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you this turn by sources your opponents control. Whenever damage from a creature is prevented this way, each commander creature you control deals damage equal to its power to that creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The second sentence (each commander you control deals damage equal to its power to the creature whose damage was prevented) has no reference to the source of the prevented damage.

cards.name: Reckless Rage
lines: ~ deals 4 damage to target creature you don't control and 2 damage to target creature you control.
cards.backTranslation: Target creature an opponent controls gets 4 damage. Target creature you control gets 2 damage.

cards.name: Ingenious Mastery
lines: If the {2}{U} cost was paid, you draw three cards, then an opponent creates two Treasure tokens and they scry 2. If that cost wasn't paid, you draw X cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition can test whether the alternative {2}{U} cost was paid, so the two branches cannot be selected.

cards.name: Wild Unraveling
lines: As an additional cost to cast this spell, blight 2 or pay {1}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no blight cost, and no either-or additional cost choice between blighting 2 and paying {1}.

cards.name: Uncover the Moon-Letters
lines: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may draw X cards, where X is the amount of mana spent to cast that spell. If you do, discard two cards.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast a spell that isn't a creature spell, you may have this ability: draw cards equal to the mana spent to cast that spell, then discard two cards.

cards.name: Thwip!
lines: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains flying until end of turn. If it's a Spider, you gain 2 life.
cards.backTranslation:
Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains flying until end of turn.
If the target creature is a Spider, you gain 2 life.

cards.name: Worship
lines: If you control a creature, damage that would reduce your life total to less than 1 reduces it to 1 instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no static or replacement rule that reduces damage to a life total to 1 conditioned on controlling a creature; angelGrace is only a this-turn spell effect.

cards.name: Mindclaw Shaman
lines: When this creature enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You may cast an instant or sorcery spell from among those cards without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets a player cast a spell from an opponent's revealed hand without paying its mana cost (castAnyFromHandFree and castOneFromHandFreeUpTo only cover the caster's own hand).

cards.name: Kemba, Kha Enduring
lines: Whenever ~ or another Cat you control enters, attach up to one target Equipment you control to that creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema can attach only the source or the trigger object (attach, attachSelfTo), not a targeted Equipment the controller chooses to attach to the entering Cat.

cards.name: Aether Flash
lines: Whenever a creature enters, this enchantment deals 2 damage to it.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature enters the battlefield, this enchantment deals 2 damage to that creature.

cards.name: Scrounge for Eternity
lines: Return target creature or Spacecraft card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Then create a Lander token.
cards.backTranslation: Choose target creature or Spacecraft card with mana value 5 or less in your graveyard. Put that card onto the battlefield. Create a colorless Lander artifact token named Lander with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle."
differences: Text A's spell has an additional cost (sacrifice an artifact or creature) that Text B does not mention; the cost changes what happens when the spell is cast.

cards.name: Match the Odds
lines: Create a 1/1 white Ally creature token. Put a +1/+1 counter on it for each creature your opponents control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The counters must go on the Ally token just created, and no effect reference names the token a create effect just made (only attached, trigger, source or target references exist).

cards.name: Wilt-Leaf Liege
lines: If a spell or ability an opponent controls causes you to discard this card, put it onto the battlefield instead of putting it into your graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no discard replacement that puts this card onto the battlefield when an opponent's spell or ability causes it to be discarded.

cards.name: Eternal Dragon
lines: {3}{W}{W}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only during your upkeep.
cards.backTranslation: {3}{W}{W}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only during your upkeep and only while this card is in a graveyard.

cards.name: Hypnotic Siren
lines: You control enchanted creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'You control enchanted creature' is a control-change effect for as long as the Aura stays attached; ContinuousOp has no control layer, and gainControl durations (permanent, untilEndOfTurn, whileSourceOnBattlefield) do not end when the Aura is unattached.

cards.name: Lotus Ring
lines: Equipped creature gets +3/+3 and has vigilance and "{T}, Sacrifice this creature: Add three mana of any one color."
cards.backTranslation:
Equipped creature gets +3/+3 and has vigilance.
Equipped creature has "{T}, Sacrifice this creature: Add three mana of one color chosen from white, blue, black, red, or green."

cards.name: Reckless Crew
lines: Create X 2/1 red Dwarf Berserker creature tokens, where X is the number of Vehicles you control plus the number of Equipment you control. For each of those tokens, you may attach an Equipment you control to it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The token count is the sum of Vehicles and Equipment you control, which no single countPermanents selector gives without double-counting, and the per-token optional attach of an Equipment has no schema form.

cards.name: Sami's Curiosity
lines: You gain 2 life. Create a Lander token.
cards.backTranslation:
You gain 2 life.
Create a colorless Lander artifact token. It has "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Search for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle."

cards.name: Eater of Days
lines: When this creature enters, you skip your next two turns.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that makes the controller skip their next two turns.

cards.name: Deeproot Wayfinder
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, surveil 1, then you may return a land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no combat-damage-to-a-battle trigger, so the 'or battle' half of the line cannot be modeled.

cards.name: Dismiss into Dream
lines: Each creature your opponents control is an Illusion in addition to its other types and has "When this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability, sacrifice it."
cards.backTranslation:
Each creature your opponents control is an Illusion in addition to its other creature types.
Each creature your opponents control has "Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability, sacrifice this creature."

cards.name: Instrument of the Bards
lines: {3}{G}, {T}: Search your library for a creature card with mana value equal to the number of harmony counters on ~, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If that card is legendary, create a Treasure token. Then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A search for a creature card whose mana value equals the harmony counter count cannot be written, because the mana value selectors take only fixed numbers, not a counted Value.

cards.name: Lobber Crew
lines: Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, untap this creature.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast a spell that is white and blue, white and black, white and red, white and green, blue and black, blue and red, blue and green, black and red, black and green, or red and green, untap this creature.
differences: Text A triggers on any multicolored spell; Text B lists only two-color combinations and omits spells of three or more colors.

cards.name: Dark Apostle
lines: Gift of Chaos — {3}, {T}: The next noncreature spell you cast this turn has cascade.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema does not say how a delayed 'next noncreature spell you cast this turn has cascade' is carried: nextCastThisTurn's ability kind is unspecified, and the cascade op is not documented for use outside a card's keyword.

cards.name: Iroh, Tea Master
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may have target opponent gain control of target permanent you control. When you do, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token. Put a +1/+1 counter on that token for each permanent you own that your opponents control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The 'you may have target opponent gain control of target permanent you control. When you do, ...' reflexive trigger, with a token whose counter count depends on the permanents you own that opponents control, has no schema form.

cards.name: Selesnya Eulogist
lines: {2}{G}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard, then populate.
cards.backTranslation: {2}{G}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard. Populate.

cards.name: Dovescape
lines: Whenever a player casts a noncreature spell, counter that spell. That player creates X 1/1 white and blue Bird creature tokens with flying, where X is the spell's mana value.
cards.inexpressibleReason: "Counter that spell" refers to the triggering spell without targeting, but the counter effect needs a target slot, which would let the controller choose any spell on the stack.

cards.name: Trygon Prime
lines: Subterranean Assault — Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on it and a +1/+1 counter on up to one other target attacking creature. That creature can't be blocked this turn.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Up to one target attacking creature other than this creature gets a +1/+1 counter and can't be blocked.
differences: Text A says the attacking creature can't be blocked this turn; Text B says it can't be blocked with no duration, so the duration of the unblockable effect is not the same.

cards.name: Whirlpool Rider
lines: When this creature enters, shuffle the cards from your hand into your library, then draw that many cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect shuffles only the cards from hand into the library and then draws that same number (shuffleHandGraveyardIntoLibrary also takes the graveyard).

cards.name: Kick in the Door
lines: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. That creature gains haste until end of turn and can't be blocked by Walls this turn. Venture into the dungeon.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no Venture into the dungeon effect and no 'can't be blocked by Walls this turn' effect.

cards.name: March from Velis Vel
lines: Choose a nonbasic land type. Each land you control of that type becomes a copy of target creature you control until end of turn and gains haste until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: "Choose a nonbasic land type" has no schema form, so the chosen land type cannot select the lands that become copies.

cards.name: Deathleaper, Terror Weapon
lines: Flesh Hooks — Creatures you control that entered this turn have double strike.
cards.backTranslation: Creatures you control that entered the battlefield this turn have double strike.

cards.name: Haruspex
lines: Devouring Monster — {T}, Remove X +1/+1 counters from this creature: Add X mana of any one color.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The mana ability removes X +1/+1 counters as a cost and adds X mana, but a mana ability cannot announce a variable X removal cost tied to the amount of mana produced.

cards.name: Guided Passage
lines: Reveal the cards in your library. An opponent chooses from among them a creature card, a land card, and a noncreature, nonland card. You put the chosen cards into your hand. Then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: An opponent choosing one card of each of three categories from a revealed library has no schema form, since the only choice-from-library ops let the controller choose.

cards.name: Natural Affinity
lines: All lands become 2/2 creatures until end of turn. They're still lands.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No one-shot effect makes every land become a 2/2 creature until end of turn; becomeCreatureUntilEot takes a single target.

cards.name: Footbottom Feast
lines: Put any number of target creature cards from your graveyard on top of your library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Targets have no unbounded count and no effect puts each of several chosen graveyard cards on top of the library, so 'any number of target creature cards' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Root Manipulation
lines: Until end of turn, creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain menace and "Whenever this creature attacks, you gain 1 life."
cards.inexpressibleReason: Granting a triggered ability ('Whenever this creature attacks, you gain 1 life') to each creature you control until end of turn has no form: grantAbilityUntilEot takes a single target and no each-creature form exists.

cards.name: Cataclysmic Prospecting
lines: ~ deals X damage to each creature. For each mana from a Desert spent to cast this spell, create a tapped Treasure token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no count of mana spent from Desert lands on a spell, so 'for each mana from a Desert spent to cast this spell, create a tapped Treasure' cannot be expressed (treasureManaSpent counts only Treasure mana).

cards.name: Corporeal Projection
lines: Target creature you control gains myriad until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Myriad is not a keyword in the schema's KeywordAbility list, so it cannot be granted until end of turn.

cards.name: Research the Deep
lines: Draw a card. Clash with an opponent. If you win, return ~ to its owner's hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Clash keyword action has no effect in the schema.

cards.name: Sentinel of the Nameless City
lines: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, create a Map token.

smoke.detail: threw: event object information has no bound event object

cards.backTranslation:
When this creature enters, create a Map token.
Whenever this creature attacks, create a Map token.
A Map token is a colorless Map artifact with "{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target creature you control explores. Activate only as a sorcery."

cards.name: Reverse the Sands
lines: Redistribute any number of players' life totals.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Redistributing players' life totals has no op.

cards.name: Trollbred Guardian
lines: {2}{G}: Adapt 2.
cards.backTranslation: {2}{G}: If this creature has no +1/+1 counters on it, put two +1/+1 counters on it.

cards.name: Sarinth Greatwurm
lines: Whenever a land enters, create a tapped Powerstone token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Powerstone's mana may not be spent on nonartifact spells but is otherwise unrestricted, and a mana restriction can only limit purposes or filter by source, which would also restrict its use for abilities.

cards.name: Scorching Dragonfire
lines: ~ deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no replacement that exiles a creature or planeswalker instead of putting it into the graveyard if it would die this turn.

cards.name: Tavern Swindler
lines: {T}, Pay 3 life: Flip a coin. If you win the flip, you gain 6 life.
cards.backTranslation: {T}, Pay 3 life: Flip a coin. If you win the flip, you gain 6 life. If you lose the flip, nothing happens.

cards.name: Scrapheap
lines: Whenever an artifact or enchantment is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, you gain 1 life.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever an artifact or enchantment you own leaves the battlefield and is put into a graveyard, you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Repeal
lines: Return target nonland permanent with mana value X to its owner's hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target must have mana value equal to the spell's announced X; the mana value selectors take only fixed bounds, not the announced X.

cards.name: Ghitu Encampment
lines: {1}{R}: ~ becomes a 2/1 red Warrior creature with first strike until end of turn. It's still a land.
cards.backTranslation: {1}{R}: Until end of turn, this becomes a 2/1 red Warrior creature with first strike.
differences: Text A says the land is still a land after becoming a creature; Text B does not say it remains a land, so it would lose its land type.

cards.name: Peer Pressure
lines: Choose a creature type. If you control more creatures of that type than each other player, you gain control of all creatures of that type.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition comparing your count of the chosen creature type against each other player's count, and no sorcery effect that chooses a creature type and then gains control of all creatures of that type.

cards.name: Moonstone Harbinger
lines: Whenever you gain or lose life during your turn, Bats you control get +1/+0 and gain deathtouch until end of turn. This ability triggers only once each turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: One trigger for gaining or losing life during your turn that fires only once each turn needs a single combined trigger, but the schema has separate gain and lose life triggers, and only the lose-life head carries a once-per-turn form.

cards.name: Fleshwrither
lines: Transfigure {1}{B}{B}
cards.backTranslation: {1}{B}, Sacrifice this creature: Activate this ability only as a sorcery. Search for a creature card with mana value 4, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
differences: Text A's Transfigure cost is {1}{B}{B}; Text B's activation cost is {1}{B}.
Text A searches for a creature card with the same mana value as the source; Text B searches only for a creature card with mana value 4.

cards.name: Silverquill, the Disputant
lines: Each instant and sorcery spell you cast has casualty 1.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No field grants a casualty cost to the instant and sorcery spells you cast (optionalAdditionalCost covers only kicker, squad, offspring and replicate).

cards.name: Mushroom Watchdogs
lines: Sacrifice a Food: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. It gains vigilance until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.backTranslation: Sacrifice a Food you control (other than this creature): Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and it gains vigilance until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Scuttletide
lines: Crabs you control get +1/+1 as long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: As long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, each creature you control that is a Crab gets +1/+1.

cards.name: The Lion-Turtle
lines: ~ can't attack or block unless there are three or more Lesson cards in your graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No static or rule static can stop this creature from attacking or blocking unless a condition holds (Lesson cards in your graveyard).

cards.name: Stormbeacon Blade
lines: Whenever equipped creature attacks, draw a card if you control three or more attacking creatures.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever equipped creature attacks, if you control three or more attacking creatures, draw a card.

cards.name: Of One Mind
lines: This spell costs {2} less to cast if you control a Human creature and a non-Human creature.
cards.backTranslation: This spell costs {2} less to cast as long as you control at least one Human creature and at least one creature that isn't a Human.

cards.name: Diligent Farmhand
lines: If this card is in a graveyard, effects from spells named Muscle Burst count it as a card named Muscle Burst.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no way to make effects of spells named Muscle Burst count this card, while in a graveyard, as a card with that name.

cards.name: Riddles in the Dark
lines: Look at the top four cards of your library and separate them into a face-down pile and a face-up pile. An opponent chooses one of the piles. Put that pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect where the controller separates the top four cards into two piles and an opponent chooses which pile goes to hand, with the other to the graveyard.

cards.name: Assert Authority
lines: Counter target spell. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: Counter target spell. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.

cards.name: Grey Host Reinforcements
lines: When this creature enters, exile target player's graveyard. Put a number of +1/+1 counters on this creature equal to the number of creature cards exiled this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value counts the creature cards exiled by exileTargetPlayerGraveyard, so the number of +1/+1 counters cannot be set from that exile.

cards.name: The Wondrous Wasp
lines: Wasp's Sting — When ~ enters, tap up to one target creature. It loses all abilities for as long as ~ remains on the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The targeted creature loses all abilities for as long as this creature remains on the battlefield; no static effect can select the object chosen as the trigger's target.

cards.name: Wasitora, Nekoru Queen
lines: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, that player sacrifices a creature of their choice. If the player can't, you create a 3/3 black, red, and green Cat Dragon creature token with flying.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The "if the player can't [sacrifice], create a token" branch needs a condition that the damaged player controls no creature, and conditions count permanents only relative to you, not to the event player.

cards.name: Corpses of the Lost
lines: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, you may pay 1 life. If you do, return this enchantment to its owner's hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The condition "if you descended this turn" (a permanent card put into your graveyard this turn) has no condition form in the schema.

cards.name: Wall of Essence
lines: Whenever this creature is dealt combat damage, you gain that much life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The dealtDamage trigger cannot be restricted to combat damage, so 'is dealt combat damage' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Dread Statuary
lines: {4}: ~ becomes a 4/2 Golem artifact creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
cards.backTranslation: {4}: Until end of turn, this becomes a 4/2 Golem creature.
differences: Text A makes the land an artifact creature; Text B makes it only a Golem creature and does not add the artifact type.
Text A says the land is still a land; Text B does not say it remains a land, so it would lose its land type.

cards.name: Sinister Waltz
lines: Choose three target creature cards in your graveyard. Return two of them at random to the battlefield and put the other on the bottom of your library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no effect that returns a random two of the chosen graveyard cards to the battlefield while putting the remaining chosen card on the bottom of the library (reanimateEachChosen returns all chosen cards, not a random subset).

cards.name: Applied Geometry
lines: Create a token that's a copy of target non-Aura permanent you control, except it's a 0/0 Fractal creature in addition to its other types. Put six +1/+1 counters on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: createTokenCopyOf can add card types but not the creature subtype Fractal, so the copy cannot be a Fractal in addition to its other types.

cards.name: Water Tribe Rallier
lines: Waterbend {5}: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card with power 3 or less from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The waterbend cost lets the player tap artifacts and creatures to pay for mana, which no cost shape in the schema can express, and the look-at-top-four filter 'creature card with power 3 or less' has no library-card selector for power.

cards.name: Steel Leaf Champion
lines: ~ can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no evasion restriction that stops blocking by creatures with power 2 or less specifically (cantBlockCreatures is keyed to the blocker being weaker than the source's power, and minBlockers is a minimum-blocker rule).

cards.name: Wisecrack
lines: Target creature deals damage equal to its power to itself. If that creature is attacking, ~ deals 2 damage to that creature's controller.
cards.backTranslation:
Target creature deals damage equal to its power to itself.
If that creature is attacking, deal 2 damage to that creature's controller.

cards.name: Omnibian
lines: {T}: Target creature becomes a Frog with base power and toughness 3/3 until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Target creature becomes a Frog creature with base power and toughness 3/3 until end of turn. It has no keywords.
differences: Text B says the animated creature has no keywords (it loses all keywords); Text A grants no such loss and does not remove the creature's abilities.

cards.name: Spitemare
lines: Whenever this creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to any target.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to any target.

cards.name: Zaffai and the Tempests
lines: Once during each of your turns, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op grants a once-per-turn free cast limited to instant or sorcery cards from hand (castOneFromHandFreeUpTo filters by mana value, not card type).

cards.name: Dwarven Mattock
lines: When this Equipment enters, attach it to target Dwarf you control.
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, attach this to target Dwarf creature you control.

cards.name: Red Sun's Zenith
lines: ~ deals X damage to any target. If a creature dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead. Shuffle ~ into its owner's library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no replacement that exiles a creature dealt damage this way instead of putting it into the graveyard if it would die this turn.

cards.name: Displacement Wave
lines: Return all nonland permanents with mana value X or less to their owners' hands.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The selector's mana value bound (manaValueAtMost) takes a fixed number, not the announced X, so 'nonland permanents with mana value X or less' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Smaug the Impenetrable
lines: Whenever ~ is dealt noncombat damage, create that many Treasure tokens.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The dealtDamage trigger cannot be limited to noncombat damage, so it would also fire on combat damage.

cards.name: Eyes Everywhere
lines: {5}{U}: Exchange control of this enchantment and target nonland permanent. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no exchange-control effect that swaps control of this enchantment and a target nonland permanent (gainControl and gainControlTarget only take one permanent and give it to the controller).

cards.name: Magus of the Mirror
lines: {T}, Sacrifice this creature: Exchange life totals with target opponent. Activate only during your upkeep.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect in the schema exchanges life totals between two players, so 'Exchange life totals with target opponent' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Jeskai Revelation
lines: Return target spell or permanent to its owner's hand. ~ deals 4 damage to any target. Create two 1/1 white Monk creature tokens with prowess. Draw two cards. You gain 4 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target 'spell or permanent' has no target kind covering any spell or any permanent including lands (spellOrNonlandPermanent excludes lands).

cards.name: Dagger Caster
lines: When this creature enters, it deals 1 damage to each opponent and 1 damage to each creature your opponents control.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, each opponent takes 1 damage. This creature deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control.

cards.name: Precursor Golem
lines: Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell that targets only a single Golem, that player copies that spell for each other Golem that spell could target. Each copy targets a different one of those Golems.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Copying a spell once for each other Golem it could target, with each copy retargeted to a different Golem, has no op.

cards.name: Horrid Shadowspinner
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, you may draw cards equal to its power. If you do, discard that many cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The discard op takes only a fixed number, so it cannot discard the same dynamic count (equal to this creature's power) that the draw uses.

cards.name: Dominating Vampire
lines: When this creature enters, gain control of target creature with mana value less than or equal to the number of Vampires you control until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A target filter's mana value bound is a fixed number (manaValueAtMost takes a constant n), so 'mana value less than or equal to the number of Vampires you control' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Mathas, Fiend Seeker
lines: At the beginning of your end step, put a bounty counter on target creature an opponent controls. For as long as that creature has a bounty counter on it, it has "When this creature dies, each opponent draws a card and gains 2 life."
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect makes each opponent gain life: gainLife only affects the ability's controller, and eachPlayerGainsLife has no opponent scope.

cards.name: Old Man Willow
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or a token. When you do, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The 'you may sacrifice another creature or a token. When you do, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2' reflexive trigger needs its target chosen only after the optional sacrifice, and the schema has reflexive sacrifice only for the source itself (sacrificeSourceThenReflexive); sacrificeOneThen has no optional flag and would announce the target with the attack trigger.

cards.name: Overburden
lines: Whenever a player puts a nontoken creature onto the battlefield, that player returns a land they control to its owner's hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'That player returns a land they control' needs the event player to choose the land, and the schema does not say whether returnOneToHand lets the event player choose rather than the controller.

cards.name: Ecological Appreciation
lines: Search your library and graveyard for up to four creature cards with different names that each have mana value X or less and reveal them. An opponent chooses two of those cards. Shuffle the chosen cards into your library and put the rest onto the battlefield. Exile ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no search across library and graveyard combined, nor an opponent-chosen split of the found cards between library shuffle and battlefield.

cards.name: Disciple of Griselbrand
lines: {1}, Sacrifice a creature: You gain life equal to the sacrificed creature's toughness.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value reads the toughness of the creature sacrificed as a cost, and toughnessOfSource reads the source itself.

cards.name: Renegade Reaper
lines: When this creature enters, mill four cards. If at least one Angel card is milled this way, you gain 4 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition that checks whether a card of a given type (an Angel) was milled by the immediately preceding mill, so 'if at least one Angel card is milled this way, you gain 4 life' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Gutless Plunderer
lines: When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, look at the top three cards of your library. You may put one of those cards back on top of your library. Put the rest into your graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no condition for 'if you attacked this turn' (hadToAttackThisCombat checks a different thing), so the raid intervening-if cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Boomer Scrapper
lines: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, you lose 1 life and create a Junk token.
cards.backTranslation:
When this creature enters, you lose 1 life and create a Junk token.
Whenever this creature attacks, you lose 1 life and create a Junk token.
The Junk token is an artifact with the following ability: "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card. Activate only as a sorcery."

cards.name: Bitterheart Witch
lines: When this creature dies, you may search your library for a Curse card, put it onto the battlefield attached to target player, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Putting a Curse onto the battlefield attached to a target player is not expressible: attach moves an Aura or Equipment onto a permanent, and no op attaches an Aura to a player.

cards.name: Cephalid Constable
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, return up to that many target permanents that player controls to their owner's hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The number of target permanents is the combat damage dealt (a dynamic count), and the schema's target slot count is a fixed min/max, not a value taken from the damage.

cards.name: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds
lines: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, you get that many additional upkeep steps after this phase.
cards.inexpressibleReason: "You get that many additional upkeep steps after this phase" has no effect form in the schema (only extra combat phases exist).

cards.name: Arlinn, Voice of the Pack
lines: Each creature you control that's a Wolf or a Werewolf enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
cards.backTranslation: Each creature you control that is a Wolf or a Werewolf enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.

cards.name: Saiba Cryptomancer
lines: Backup 1
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature and that creature gains hexproof until end of turn.

cards.name: Dream Halls
lines: Rather than pay the mana cost for a spell, its controller may discard a card that shares a color with that spell.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The alternative cost is a discard of a card sharing a color with the spell being cast; no cost can reference the color of the spell being cast.

cards.name: Goblin Tunneler
lines: {T}: Target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked until end of turn.

cards.name: Candlestick
lines: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has "Whenever this creature attacks, surveil 2."
cards.backTranslation:
Equipped creature gets +1/+1.
Equipped creature has "Whenever this creature attacks, surveil 2."

cards.name: Gauntlet of Might
lines: Whenever a Mountain is tapped for mana, its controller adds an additional {R}.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a Mountain is tapped for mana, it produces an additional {R}.

cards.name: Kitchen Imp
lines: Madness {B}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Madness (discard into exile, then cast it for its madness cost) has no form in the schema; AlternativeCast kinds do not include it.

cards.name: Kyoshi Battle Fan
lines: When this Equipment enters, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token, then attach this Equipment to it.
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token, then attach this to it.

cards.name: Courier Bat
lines: When this creature enters, if you gained life this turn, return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition reads whether you gained life this turn, so the enters trigger's 'if you gained life this turn' intervening-if cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Clear Shot
lines: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. It deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
cards.backTranslation: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Then target creature an opponent controls is dealt damage equal to the power of the first target creature, with the first target creature as the source of that damage.

cards.name: Forked Bolt
lines: ~ deals 2 damage divided as you choose among one or two targets.
cards.backTranslation: Choose one or two targets. This spell deals 2 damage divided as you choose among them.

cards.name: Primal Adversary
lines: When this creature enters, you may pay {1}{G} any number of times. When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature, then up to that many target lands you control become 3/3 Wolf creatures with haste that are still lands.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no way to pay {1}{G} any number of times with counters equal to the number paid and up to that many target lands becoming creatures.

cards.name: Dead Before Sunrise
lines: Until end of turn, outlaw creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain "{T}: ~ deals damage equal to its power to target creature."
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect grants an activated ability to every creature matching a selector, since grantAbilityUntilEot takes a single target.

cards.name: Resplendent Marshal
lines: When this creature enters or dies, you may exile another creature card from your graveyard. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control other than this creature that shares a creature type with the exiled card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The counters go on each creature that shares a creature type with the exiled card, which needs a per-exiled-card subtype selector the schema does not have, and the 'you may ... when you do' reflexive link cannot carry that type.

cards.name: Glory
lines: {2}{W}: Choose a color. Creatures you control gain protection from the chosen color until end of turn. Activate only if this card is in your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation:
{2}{W}, Activate this ability only from a graveyard: Choose one —
• Creatures you control gain protection from white until end of turn.
• Creatures you control gain protection from blue until end of turn.
• Creatures you control gain protection from black until end of turn.
• Creatures you control gain protection from red until end of turn.
• Creatures you control gain protection from green until end of turn.

cards.name: Overwrite the Multiverse
lines: Exile all creatures. Empower Jace X, where X is the number of creatures exiled this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The number of creatures exiled this way cannot be read after exileEach, and a Jace planeswalker token with loyalty abilities cannot be created or empowered.

cards.name: Boon of Boseiju
lines: Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the greatest mana value among permanents you control. Untap it.
cards.backTranslation: Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the greatest mana value among permanents you control. Untap that creature.

cards.name: Noble Benefactor
lines: When this creature dies, each player may search their library for a card and put that card into their hand. Then each player who searched their library this way shuffles.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each player (not only the controller) may search their library and then only the players who searched shuffle, and no effect op lets every player make an optional search with a conditional shuffle.

cards.name: Celebrate the Harvest
lines: Search your library for up to X basic land cards, where X is the number of different powers among creatures you control. Put those cards onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The search count 'number of different powers among creatures you control' has no Value kind that counts distinct power values.

cards.name: Jugan, the Rising Star
lines: When ~ dies, you may distribute five +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect distributes a fixed number of +1/+1 counters divided among chosen targets (dealDamageDivided is damage only, and putCountersEachChosen gives each target the same count).

cards.name: Eagle of Deliverance
lines: When this creature enters, put an indestructible counter on another target creature you control. Draw a card if that creature's power is 2 or less.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no meaning for an 'indestructible' counter: the only indestructible grant is the keyword, so putting that counter on the target cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Lich Lord of Unx
lines: {U}{U}{B}{B}: Target player loses X life and mills X cards, where X is the number of Zombies you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: millTargetPlayer takes a fixed number, so a target player's mill count equal to the Zombies you control cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Curious Inquiry
lines: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, investigate."

cards.backTranslation:
Enchanted creature gets +1/+1.
Enchanted creature has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a colorless Clue artifact token with "{2}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card."

cards.name: Exquisite Archangel
lines: If you would lose the game, instead exile this creature and your life total becomes equal to your starting life total.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The replacement 'if you would lose the game, instead exile this creature and your life total becomes equal to your starting life total' has no replacement-effect shape for losing the game in the schema.

cards.name: Curse of Vitality
lines: Whenever enchanted player is attacked, you gain 2 life. Each opponent attacking that player does the same.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The half 'each opponent attacking that player gains 2 life' has no opponents-only option on life gain for another player, so the curse's controller attacking the enchanted player would also gain the extra life.

cards.name: Underfoot Underdogs
lines: {1}, {T}: Target creature you control with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.
cards.backTranslation: {1}, {T}: Target creature you control with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.

cards.name: Epiphany at the Drownyard
lines: Reveal the top X plus one cards of your library and separate them into two piles. An opponent chooses one of those piles. Put that pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect reveals the top X plus one cards, separates them into two piles, and lets an opponent choose one pile (the separatePermanentsIntoPiles ops act on permanents, not library cards).

cards.name: You're Not Alone
lines: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If you control three or more creatures, it gets +4/+4 until end of turn instead.
cards.backTranslation: Target creature gets +4/+4 until end of turn if you control three or more creatures. Otherwise, that creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

cards.name: Hope Estheim
lines: At the beginning of your end step, each opponent mills X cards, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no Value for the amount of life you gained this turn, so the mill count X cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Locust Miser
lines: Each opponent's maximum hand size is reduced by two.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no rule static that reduces an opponent's maximum hand size; noMaximumHandSize is the only hand-size static.

cards.name: Weaponcraft Enthusiast
lines: Fabricate 2
cards.backTranslation:
When this creature enters, choose one.
• Put two +1/+1 counters on this creature.
• Create two 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature tokens.

cards.name: Cerebral Vortex
lines: Target player draws two cards, then ~ deals damage to that player equal to the number of cards they've drawn this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no value for the number of cards a player has drawn this turn, so the damage amount 'equal to the number of cards they've drawn this turn' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Gauntlets of Light
lines: Enchanted creature gets +0/+2 and assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no field or op that makes combat damage be assigned equal to the creature's toughness instead of its power.

cards.name: Dollhouse of Horrors
lines: {1}, {T}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a token that's a copy of the exiled card, except it's a 0/0 Construct artifact in addition to its other types and it has "~ gets +1/+1 for each Construct you control." It gains haste until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot choose a creature card exiled as this activation's cost and copy that exact card into a token with a 0/0 Construct type and a granted '+1/+1 for each Construct you control' ability (createTokenCopyOf has no added static effects or type-and-ability override for the copy).

cards.name: Verdant Mastery
lines: Search your library for up to four basic land cards and reveal them. Put one of them onto the battlefield tapped under an opponent's control if the {3}{G} cost was paid. Put two of them onto the battlefield tapped under your control and the rest into your hand. Then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot make the destination of the searched lands depend on whether the alternative {3}{G} cost was paid (one opponent-controlled land versus two under your control).

cards.name: Despotic Scepter
lines: {T}: Destroy target permanent you own. It can't be regenerated.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Destroy target permanent you own. It can't be regenerated.

cards.name: Loxodon Gatekeeper
lines: Artifacts, creatures, and lands your opponents control enter tapped.
cards.backTranslation: Artifacts, creatures, and lands your opponents control enter the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Choice of Damnations
lines: Target opponent chooses a number. You may have that player lose that much life. If you don't, that player sacrifices all but that many permanents of their choice.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The targeted opponent announces a number, then the controller chooses whether that player loses that much life, otherwise the player sacrifices all but that many permanents; no op models the announced number or this choice.

cards.name: Misfortune Teller
lines: Whenever this creature enters or deals combat damage to a player, exile target card from a graveyard. If it was a creature card, create a 2/2 black Rogue creature token. If it was a land card, create a Treasure token. Otherwise, you gain 3 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The creature-card and land-card tests must read the targeted card's type after it has been exiled from the graveyard, and the schema does not state that a checkTarget condition reads an exiled card.

cards.name: Blood Reckoning
lines: Whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, that creature's controller loses 1 life.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature attacks, if you are the defending player, the event player loses 1 life.

cards.name: Djeru, With Eyes Open
lines: If a source would deal damage to a planeswalker you control, prevent 1 of that damage.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no way to prevent a fixed amount (1) of damage dealt to planeswalkers you control; the only damage-prevention shield prevents all of it.

cards.name: The Eighth Doctor
lines: Once during each of your turns, you may play a historic land or cast a historic permanent spell from your graveyard. If you do, it gains "If this permanent would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema can express the graveyard play permission for historic cards, but not the clause that the played permanent gains 'if this permanent would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else'.

cards.name: Marshal of the Lost
lines: Whenever you attack, target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of attacking creatures.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you attack, target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of attacking creatures.

cards.name: Crackdown
lines: Nonwhite creatures with power 3 or greater don't untap during their controllers' untap steps.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No static effect stops other permanents from untapping during their controllers' untap steps.

cards.name: Impede Momentum
lines: Tap target creature and put three stun counters on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A stun counter's rule (if a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one instead) has no schema form, so the three stun counters would not behave as printed.

cards.name: Concerted Defense
lines: Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {1} plus an additional {1} for each creature in your party.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The counter's unless-pays cost is a fixed ParsedManaCost, and the schema cannot express {1} plus {1} for each creature in your party (a dynamic party count).
